title: Commit live orders atomically and authorize private receipts
acceptance_criteria: Accept bounded contacts/date, explicit current consent and configurations, not client amounts. Resolve public tenant from route/session regardless of owner identity; lock and check time/access/publication/revision after lock, reprice server-side, and require explicit reconfirmation on stale prices or consent.

Commit scoped customer/order/immutable snapshots and one-time same-attempt photo attachment atomically. Identical racing retries create one order; prior committed identical retry gives non-PII acknowledgement only even after repricing/expiry; different payload conflicts.

Authorize no-store minimal receipts with the same eligible receipt session rather than the opaque ID alone. Clear live cart and show sent copy only after commit; embed/draft can't write and demo never writes live.

Use controlled clocks and transaction barriers for tariff-edit lock order, expiry crossings, owner A submitting to B, upload swaps, unrelated receipts and no-partial-write assertions on real dependencies.
deliverables: Live order/receipt handlers and UI bindings, snapshot migrations, and deterministic phase-4 gate evidence
